key_highlights: ASX sold off as mining and banking stocks tumbled amid surging oil prices and rising bond yields; iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase
AUD weakened sharply on growth scare; oil hit highest level since May, pressuring consumer and transport sectors
RBA flagged rental inflation as a key concern, complicating rate path; Queensland credit rating downgraded for first time since 2009
Government softened gas reservation rules, easing Asian supply fears and supporting Santos (STO.AX) and energy names
Housing market showing bifurcation: high-end prices correcting sharply while affordable segment remains resilient; first-home buyer activity surging
Superannuation policy debate intensifies with One Nation proposals and early-access discussions, raising political risk for financials
Gold underperforming ('schmould') despite safe-haven flows; small-cap gold explorers (Kuniko, Gateway WA) showing exploration momentum
Mining cap-raising activity accelerating (Crucible, Canaccord-led), signalling sector stress and dilution risk

sectors.trend: Sharp sell-off; iron ore in 'bloodletting' phase, mining stocks leading ASX decline. Cap-raising activity surging as smaller miners seek cash. Gold underperforming broadly but exploration names showing activity.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX under pressure from weak iron ore demand signals. Dilution risk rising via cap raises. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) lagging. Small-caps (Kuniko, Gateway WA) offer speculative upside.

sectors.trend: Oil at highest since May; fuel prices set to rise 30c. Government relaxed gas reservation rules, supporting domestic gas producers. Santos preservation narrative strengthens STO.AX.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, STO.AX, BRL.AX benefit from oil surge and gas policy shift. Consumer cost pressure from fuel hikes weighs on WES.AX, WTW.AX.

sectors.trend: Banks tumbling alongside miners as bond yields rise and growth scare builds. RBA rental inflation concern complicates rate expectations. Superannuation policy debate adds political overhang.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from rate uncertainty. Super fund managers (HUB.AX, PPA.AX) exposed to political risk from early-access proposals.

sectors.trend: Fuel price hikes and tax burden fears pressuring consumer spending. Woolworths 'Price Freeze' breach erodes trust. Business confidence deteriorating.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WTW.AX face margin squeeze from input costs. Consumer discretionary names vulnerable. Defensive staples preferred.

sectors.trend: Housing correction underway at high end; affordable segment resilient. CBRE IM acquiring net-lease REIT signals institutional interest. Rental inflation a key RBA concern.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX) may see rental yield support. Residential developers face mixed signals. Net-lease REITs attract capital.

sectors.trend: ASX runners include Iondrive, Australasian, Aruma, Neurizon. AI and battery tech (Critical Resources) showing momentum. US tech (AVGO, UMC) positive.
sectors.implications: Speculative small-cap activity elevated. Battery/energy transition names offer thematic exposure. Limited ASX-listed pure tech plays.

key_themes: Iron ore demand deterioration and mining sector stress
Oil price surge driving energy outperformance vs consumer weakness
AUD weakness on growth scare; implications for import costs and RBA policy
RBA rental inflation dilemma constraining rate cut path
Housing market bifurcation: luxury correction vs affordable resilience
Gas policy liberalisation supporting domestic energy security
Superannuation political risk from One Nation and early-access proposals
Queensland sovereign credit downgrade signalling fiscal stress
Mining cap-raising wave indicating sector liquidity stress
Chinese inflation surge complicating commodity demand outlook

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand collapse / China slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to iron ore majors; diversify into gold, energy, and domestic-demand sectors

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil-driven inflation and RBA rate path uncertainty
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge consumer exposure; favour energy and inflation-linked assets; monitor RBA statements
Consider AUD-hedged international exposure; monitor RBA intervention signals
Monitor One Nation proposals; assess impact on HUB.AX, PPA.AX, bank deposit flows

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mining sector dilution via cap raises
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid small-cap miners with imminent raises; favour cash-flow-positive majors
Monitor QLD-linked REITs and infrastructure names; limited direct ASX impact

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy sector on oil surge and gas policy tailwind
opportunities.rationale: Oil at 5-month high; relaxed gas reservation rules support domestic producers; fuel price pass-through benefits

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to gold exploration on underperformance rebound
opportunities.rationale: Gold 'schmould' creates mean-reversion opportunity; Kuniko and Gateway WA showing exploration progress; AUD weakness supports gold

opportunities.recommendation: Add net-lease REITs on institutional accumulation
opportunities.rationale: CBRE IM $1.6B acquisition signals confidence; rental inflation supports yields; defensive in rate-uncertain environment

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore major exposure; trim BHP/RIO/FMG
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; Chinese inflation and demand concerns; cap-raising wave signals sector stress

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge consumer and transport names against fuel cost inflation
defensive_moves.rationale: 30c fuel rise and tax burden fears compress margins; Woolworths price breach signals cost pass-through

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash or short-duration bonds amid rate uncertainty
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA rental inflation concern limits cut expectations; 10-year yields at 2007 highs; late-stage bubble warning

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. Iron ore weakness and oil-driven inflation create a stagflationary tilt. RBA constrained by rental inflation, limiting rate cuts. Energy outperforms; materials and consumer lag. AUD remains vulnerable. Volatility elevated.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if iron ore stabilises and RBA eases. Gas policy reform supports energy transition. Housing correction at high end may stabilise by H2 2027. Superannuation policy resolution could unlock financials. Key variable: China demand trajectory.
